headline: The VR Disney Plus app on Meta Quest now has 3D movies
summary: Disney+ VR on Meta Quest now features over 60 3D movies. Subscribers can enjoy titles like The Avengers and Black Panther. This update rolls out today.

headline: Oura is acquiring medical AI chatbot startup Counsel Health
summary: Oura is acquiring AI chatbot startup Counsel Health for $625 million. Counsel Health's AI provides insights based on user health data. The chatbot was integrated into Oura's app earlier this year.

headline: Sony cancels live-service shooter Fairgames
summary: Sony has canceled the live-service shooter Fairgames, announced in 2023. This follows other cancellations in Sony's live-service game push. The company previously shut down some PlayStation live service titles.

headline: The PlayStation Plus PC app is shutting down next month
summary: Sony is discontinuing the PlayStation Plus PC app on December 10th. The app allowed Premium subscribers to stream games on PC. Sony cites very low usage as the reason for its shutdown.

headline: We Asked Nintendo of America's Nate Bihldorff About Localizing Ocarina of Time's Most Obscure Secrets
summary: Nintendo's localization team prioritizes obscure, hard-to-find game lines. Nate Bihldorff discussed Ocarina of Time's unique translation challenges. Insights into preserving hidden game secrets were shared.

headline: Nintendo Opens New Job Role to Preserve and Organize its Old Games
summary: Nintendo of America created a new job position for game preservation. The role focuses on archiving the company's extensive old game library. This initiative aims to protect Nintendo's gaming heritage.

headline: Pokémon TCG’s Delta Reign Elite Trainer Box Is Already Down to Almost Market Price Across Walmart & Amazon
summary: The Pokémon TCG Delta Reign Elite Trainer Box has dropped in price. Walmart sells it for $89.95, beating Amazon's $98.49. Prices are nearing market value.

headline: The Sabrent 8-Port USB Desktop Charging Station with 252W of Total Power Output Is on Sale for Black Friday
summary: The Sabrent 8-Port USB Charging Station is on Black Friday sale. It offers 252W total power output for multiple devices. Never run out of USB charging ports again.

headline: US Army soldier suspected of spying for Russia arrested in UK
summary: A 41-year-old US Army soldier was arrested in the UK. He is suspected of national security offenses and spying for Russia. The soldier is currently being questioned in London.

headline: David Walliams accused of sexual misconduct after losing injunction bid
summary: Comedian David Walliams faces sexual misconduct allegations. ITN and The Guardian report claims of preying on teenage girls and young women. Walliams has vehemently denied all accusations.

headline: Why Walliams' unprecedented legal battle to stay anonymous failed
summary: David Walliams lost a court bid to prevent allegations from being public. He sought anonymity regarding sexual misconduct claims. Reports by ITV News and The Guardian named him after the ruling.

headline: Meghan's father Thomas Markle back in federal custody after allegedly removing ankle monitor
summary: Thomas Markle, 82, is back in federal custody in Florida. He allegedly removed an ankle monitor. Markle was previously charged with possession of child sex abuse material.
